desk_reject_comments.value: This paper is desk rejected for being substantially similar to the COLING 2025 submission "Fine-grained Hallucination Mitigation and Detection in Language Model Reasoning", which is ID 2476 at COLING. The paper shares the same content, nearly identical figures, nearly identical tables, and large similarities in text. Dual submissions are not allowed at ICLR.
